description: Address the 3 issues raised in the semantic review: (1) Fix hardcoded 128x32 disconnect frame size in DMDServerBackend.disconnect(), (2) Correct the LUT optimization overstatement in docs/backends.md, (3) Fix the id() reuse hazard in the frame identity cache and add a test for the edge case.
steps: Fix DMDServerBackend.disconnect() to use tracked frame dimensions instead of hardcoded (128, 32). Store last frame dimensions from send_frame() and use them in disconnect().
Update docs/backends.md 'Optimizations' section to accurately describe what the LUT eliminates (bit-shifting per pixel) vs what remains (per-pixel iteration and bitwise OR).
Fix the id() reuse hazard in the frame identity cache by also comparing a content hash or storing a reference to the last image, and add a test covering the recycled-id edge case.
acceptance_criteria: disconnect() creates the black frame using the last known frame dimensions rather than hardcoded 128x32
docs/backends.md LUT description is technically accurate and does not overstate the optimization
The frame cache is robust against id() reuse (e.g., by keeping a reference to the last Image object)
A new test verifies that a new Image object with a recycled id() is not incorrectly served from cache
All existing tests continue to pass
flake8, mypy, and black pass on modified files
verification: Run 'uv run --extra dev pytest tests/ -v --tb=short' to verify all tests pass
Run 'uv run --extra dev black zeclock/ tests/ --check'
